meta.source: Sampled from six SOCOM II golden frames (parity gate, 640x448): s19 MISSION BRIEFING overview, s19 deploy, s08 SELECT RANK, s07 main menu. Values are the game's own; the 'site' tokens are the one-step refinements that clear WCAG 4.5:1 and say so in their usage note.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything: the game's screen between panels. Site body background and the viewer's canvas margin.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Letterbox and the boot screen. Only where the game shows true black.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Content panel and card fill (game: the briefing text panel). Stat tiles, about-screen panel, story cards.

tokens.name: panel-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on every panel and tab. Decorative, never load-bearing: 1.3:1 on panel.

tokens.name: tab
tokens.usage: Resting tab and button fill (game: unlit MISSION DETAILS tab).

tokens.name: tab-lit
tokens.usage: The current tab and a hovered button (game: lit OVERVIEW tab). Dark on purpose: the game's lit tab is dark teal, not bright. Label on it is `gold`, 5.39:1.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Roller and list selection pulse (game: SELECT RANK lit item). Only `text-strong` reads on it (6.29:1); never put `gold` or `text` on it.

tokens.name: highlight-pressed
tokens.usage: The one-frame flash when a tab is selected (game: DEPLOY at the moment of CROSS). Transient only, no text contract.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: SITE gold: labels, panel headings, lit-tab labels, stat numbers. Lifted one step from the game's #786e3b, which is 3.0:1 on panel; this reads 6.21:1 on panel, 5.39:1 on tab-lit, 7.91:1 on ground. Do not 'correct' it back to the frame.

tokens.name: gold-display
tokens.usage: Screen title (MISSION BRIEFING) at 40px+ and the glow colour behind it. 8.1:1 on panel.

tokens.name: gold-source
tokens.usage: The game's own label gold, kept for reference and for the classic menu only. FAILS 4.5:1 on every ground (3.0:1 on panel); never use on the modern site.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and unlit tab labels on ground, panel and tab (8.18:1 on panel). Game: briefing body text.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Subtitle line, selected roller item, anything on `highlight`. 12:1 on panel.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Captions, stat-tile captions, disclaimers, keyboard hints. 5.26:1 on panel, 4.57:1 on tab-lit; not below 13px.

tokens.name: caret
tokens.usage: The typewriter block cursor after typed text. Same tone as `text`.

tokens.name: cyan-boot
tokens.usage: Boot-screen typewriter text and cursor only (DEVELOPED BY / ZIPPER). Never as a link colour on the site.

tokens.name: glyph-square
tokens.usage: The □ hint glyph (CAREER STATS). Brightened from the game's #a94d87 (3.0:1) to 4.82:1 on panel; always paired with its word.

tokens.name: glyph-triangle
tokens.usage: The △ hint glyph (BACK). Brightened from the game's #217054 (2.57:1) to 5.55:1 on panel; always paired with its word.

tokens.name: glyph-cross
tokens.usage: The ✕ hint glyph (SELECT) and the viewer's focus ring. Brightened from the game's #3e7d86 (3.28:1) to 6.36:1 on panel.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: EXPERIMENTAL and dev-build badges in the viewer. Text on `panel` 7.3:1; as a 2px rule it is a mark, 3:1 met.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 3:1 or better on ground, panel, tab and tab-lit.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen, uppercase, `gold-display` with the title glow. Game: 28px on a 640 stage; 44px is the same ratio at 1000px.

styles.name: story-title
styles.usage: Story-page hero only, lowercase, `text-strong` with the soft glow.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab and button labels, uppercase. `text` at rest, `gold` when lit.

styles.name: panel-heading
styles.usage: The heading strip of a panel, uppercase, `gold`.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Top-nav items, uppercase, `text`; current item `gold` on `tab-lit`.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Hint bar words, uppercase, `text-strong`, glyph in its glyph colour.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: US Special Operations Command has been called upon to assist.
styles.usage: Briefing panel copy and story entries, `text`. Sentence case; the game's briefing is set this way.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Each entry has one technical line you can skip.

styles.name: lede-italic
styles.sample: Trying to turn a PlayStation 2 game into a PC game.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Viewer stats, fps counter and key hints, `text`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-word gap in the hint bar; tab border inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked tabs; tile inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tab vertical padding; panel heading padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between tab column and panel; gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a screen; stat-tile padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen title to tabs; margin around the 4:3 stage.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Story page section spacing.

tokens.name: tab-w
tokens.usage: Fixed width of the briefing tab column (game: 160 of 640 stage = 25%; 230 of 920).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tabs, panels, tiles, hint bar. The game has no rounded corners; the site follows.

tokens.name: radius-viewer
tokens.usage: Viewer settings panel and its cards only: the viewer is a tool, not a game screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The floating fullscreen button in the viewer.

tokens.name: title-glow
tokens.usage: text-shadow behind the screen title in `gold-display`.

tokens.name: story-glow
tokens.usage: text-shadow behind the story title in `text-strong`.

tokens.name: panel-inset
tokens.usage: Panel and tab edge, instead of a border, so widths stay exact.

tokens.name: viewer-lift
tokens.usage: Viewer settings panel over the 3D canvas.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: Alpha of the 2px repeating scanline over ground and panels (the CRT softening the site already uses).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: A tab or button that cannot be chosen (SERVER STATS before it exists).
